run_faiss_kmeans_clustering: run GPU-accelerated K-means clustering on a feature matrix using FAISS and return cluster centroids
create_speech_kmeans_job: create a SpeechKMeansJob dataclass with layer, km_size, km_path, and feat_path fields for k-means configuration
configure_speech_kmeans: configure a SpeechKMeansConfig with niter, max_points_per_centroid, requirements, and a list of SpeechKMeansJob instances
run_speech_kmeans_module: run the SpeechKMeans module to train k-means on speech features and save centroids to a numpy file
review_faiss_gpu_index: review the faiss_kmeans method that builds a GpuIndexFlatL2 or IndexReplicas for multi-GPU k-means training
